query: As a clinician: for my 57-year-old male, among ICU males aged 52–62, what is the IQR of first-recorded MAP at admission?
final_sql: SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value)) AS interquartile_range FROM male_admissions a JOIN male_icu i ON a.subject_id = i.subject_id;
